text_en: Hear this word that I take up over you in lamentation, O house of Israel:
text_cn: 以色列家！你们应听这话，应听我为你们唱的这首哀歌！

text_en: Fallen, no more to rise, is maiden Israel; forsaken on her land, with no one to raise her up.
text_cn: “以色列处女已跌倒，不能再起；摔在地上，无人搀扶。

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : The city that marched out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which marched out a hundred shall have ten left.
text_cn: 因为吾主上主这样论以色列家说：出一千兵的城只生还一百；出一百的，只生还十个。寻求上主者生，作恶者亡。

text_en: For thus says the Lord to the house of Israel: Seek me and live;
text_cn: 因为上主这样对以色列家说：你们寻求我，才可生存。

text_en: but do not seek Bethel, and do not enter into Gilgal or cross over to Beer-sheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into exile, and Bethel shall come to nothing.
text_cn: 不可往贝特耳求助，不可往基耳加耳，不可去贝尔舍巴，因为基耳加耳必被掳掠，贝特耳必化为乌有。

text_en: Seek the Lord and live, or he will break out against the house of Joseph like fire, and it will devour Bethel, with no one to quench it.
text_cn: 你们寻求上主，才可生存，免得他如火冲入若瑟家中， 烧毁一切，无人能为以色列家扑灭。

text_en: Ah, you that turn justice to wormwood, and bring righteousness to the ground!
text_cn: 是他创造了昴星和参星，变昏黑为黎明，使白昼为黑夜，召海水而倾流于地面，他名叫‘雅威’。

text_en: The one who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns deep darkness into the morning, and darkens the day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the Lord is his name,
text_cn: 他使灭亡闪击强者，使毁灭临于城堡。

text_en: who makes destruction flash out against the strong, so that destruction comes upon the fortress.
text_cn: 凡以毒害代替公正，弃正义于地的，是有祸的！

text_en: They hate the one who reproves in the gate, and they abhor the one who speaks the truth.
text_cn: 他们憎恨在城门口主持公道的人，厌恶讲真话的人。

text_en: Therefore because you trample on the poor and take from them levies of grain, you have built houses of hewn stone, but you shall not live in them; you have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.
text_cn: 为此，你们既然欺压穷人，向他横征钱粮，你们纵然用方石建筑了房屋，却不得住在里面；栽植了美丽的葡萄园，却喝不到园中的酒。

text_en: For I know how many are your transgressions, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the righteous, who take a bribe, and push aside the needy in the gate.
text_cn: 因为我知道你们的罪恶多端，过犯重大：欺压义人，接受贿赂，在城门口冤枉穷人；

text_en: Therefore the prudent will keep silent in such a time; for it is an evil time.
text_cn: 因此明智人在此时缄默不言，因为这是邪恶的时代。”

text_en: Seek good and not evil, that you may live; and so the Lord , the God of hosts, will be with you, just as you have said.
text_cn: “你们应寻求善，不可寻求恶：这样你们才能生存；上主万军的天主也必与你们同在，正如你们所说的。

text_en: Hate evil and love good, and establish justice in the gate; it may be that the Lord , the God of hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.
text_cn: 你们应恶恶好善，在城门口主张正义，或许万军的天主上主会怜悯若瑟的遗民。”

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord , the God of hosts, the Lord: In all the squares there shall be wailing; and in all the streets they shall say, “Alas! alas! ” They shall call the farmers to mourning, and those skilled in lamentation, to wailing;
text_cn: 为此，万军的天主，吾主上主这样说：“人必在一切广场上哀悼，人必在各街道上说：哀哉！哀哉！并且召农人来吊唁，叫会哭的人来痛哭。

text_en: in all the vineyards there shall be wailing, for I will pass through the midst of you, says the Lord .
text_cn: 在所有的葡萄园中，人必哀哭，因为我要在你中间经过”──上主说。

text_en: Alas for you who desire the day of the Lord ! Why do you want the day of the Lord ? It is darkness, not light;
text_cn: “那仰望上主的日子来临的人，是有祸的！ 上主的日子为你们有什么好处？那是黑暗而无光明之日，

text_en: as if someone fled from a lion, and was met by a bear; or went into the house and rested a hand against the wall, and was bitten by a snake.
text_cn: 好似人逃避了狮子，又遇到了狗熊；进到房屋里，手扶在墙上，却被蛇咬伤。

text_en: Is not the day of the Lord darkness, not light, and gloom with no brightness in it?
text_cn: 上主的日子岂不是黑暗而没有光明吗？那日实在幽暗而漆黑！”

text_en: I hate, I despise your festivals, and I take no delight in your solemn assemblies.
text_cn: “我痛恨厌恶你们的庆节；你们的盛会，我也不喜悦；

text_en: Even though you offer me your burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them; and the offerings of well-being of your fatted animals I will not look upon.
text_cn: 即使你们给我奉献全燔祭和素祭，我仍不悦纳；即使你们献上肥牲作和平祭，我也不垂顾。

text_en: Take away from me the noise of your songs; I will not listen to the melody of your harps.
text_cn: 让你们喧嚷的歌声远离我；你们的琴声，我也不愿再听；

text_en: But let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
text_cn: 只愿公道如水常流，正义像川流不息的江河！

text_en: Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings the forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
text_cn: 以色列家！你们在旷野中四十年，何尝给我奉献过牺牲和素祭？

text_en: You shall take up Sakkuth your king, and Kaiwan your star-god, your images, which you made for yourselves;
text_cn: 你们应抬着自己所造的偶像，即你们的君王撒雇特和你们的星神克汪，

text_en: therefore I will take you into exile beyond Damascus, says the Lord , whose name is the God of hosts.
text_cn: 因为我必使你们充军到大马士革之外，”名叫“万军的天主”的上主说。
